name: @aburi/github-action
description: GitHub Action wrapper around @aburi/cli: runs `aburi diff` for a pull request, uploads the semantic diff Markdown as a PR comment (upserted by a hidden marker), and forwards `--fail-on` so CI gates fire off Aburi's status/count clauses. Composite action; the runtime binary is resolved via `pnpm dlx @aburi/cli@<version>` so consumers pin the CLI, not this wrapper.
